kept: What else you wrote is kept with the answer; Taktus does not act on it.
confirm: Answer "{yes}" to file it, or "{no}" if I misread you.
asked_back: I could not read one of the offered answers from yours, so nothing changes. Please answer with: {answers}.
reread: Nothing was filed. Please answer again.
not_filed: This answer is not filed: only the owner, or someone the owner named, answers here.
closed: This request is answered already; your message changes nothing.
not_shown: Nothing of that name can be shown to you here.
change_started: I am working out your change to {process} in run {run}. The proposal will be on the process's page below.
rehearsing: Rehearsing {proposal} in run {run}; nothing leaves the system.
commission_read: I read this as: commission {proposal}, which makes version {version} of {process} active.
rollback_read: I read this as: make version {version} of {process} current again, as a new version.
rolled_back: {process} is at version {version} again, as version {new}.
act_refused: That cannot be done now; the process's page says why.
evaluation_passed: Its evaluation passed: on {cases} cases the active version scores {active} and the proposal {proposed}, within a tolerance of {tolerance}.
evaluation_regressed: Its evaluation regressed: on {cases} cases the active version scores {active} and the proposal {proposed}, more than {tolerance} lower. It is commissioned against that verdict only with your reason, on the process's page.
evaluation_incomplete: Its evaluation is incomplete: {unscored} of {cases} cases have no score. It is commissioned against that verdict only with your reason, on the process's page.
evaluation_running: Its evaluation on {cases} cases is still running. It can be commissioned once every case is scored.
takeover_read: I read this as: take over step {step} of run {run}. Its worker stops at its next boundary, and the run waits for you until you hand the result back or the take-over's time runs out.
takeover_asked: Asked as {takeover}: step {step} of run {run} stops at its worker's next boundary. Then "show takeover {takeover}" shows what it reached, and "hand back {takeover}: <your result>" hands the result back.
takeover_waiting: {takeover} is asked; the worker of step {step} has not reached its next boundary yet.
takeover_refused: {takeover} was refused: step {step} ended before its worker stopped, and it was not taken over.
takeover_lapsed: {takeover} lapsed: its time ran out without a hand-back, and step {step} went back to its worker at its checkpoint. Nothing was handed back.
takeover_handed: {takeover} was handed back: the result of step {step} counts as a person's.
hand_back_read: I read this as: hand back {takeover} with your result {form}. It becomes the result of step {step} of run {run}, produced by you, and the run continues.
as_text: as text, exactly as you wrote it
handed_back: Handed back: step {step} of run {run} is done, as yours, and the run continues.
takeover_not_done: That cannot be taken over or handed back now; the run's page says why.
steer_read: I read this as: send step {step} of run {run} the message "{text}". Its worker receives it at its next boundary, and the steps after that take it as an input; it changes nothing the step may do or spend.
steered: Sent as {message}: step {step} of run {run} receives it at its worker's next boundary.
spend_of_run: Where run {run} spent, step by step:
spend_against: Run {run} and run {other} side by side, step by step:
spend_of_process: Where process {process} spent over {days} days, in {runs} runs, step by step:
catalogue_heading: What you may ask Taktus for:
catalogue_needs: {name}: needs {inputs}; start it in the web app
start_read: I read this as: start {process} ({name}) on your behalf.
start_demand: It is estimated at {estimate}, which reaches half or more of what remains of {limits}; your yes accepts that.
start_not_done: That cannot be started from here; the list in the web app says why.

briefs.escalated_ask: Remove the cause and resume, or leave it stopped.
briefs.escalated_ask_hand: Remove the cause and resume, do the step by hand, or leave it stopped.
briefs.backlog_ask: Each one is listed on the page: resume it, do it by hand, or leave it.
briefs.deviated: {process}: a partner's message at step {step} breaks its contract
briefs.deviated_ask: Ask the partner for a correct message, or decide on the page.
briefs.recurred: {process}: step {step} was healed {count} times for the same failure
briefs.recurred_ask: Change the process so the failure no longer occurs, or accept it.
briefs.signal_ask: Work the case on its page; close the incident once it is worked.
briefs.interface_broken: The interface {interface} stopped working as expected
briefs.interface_ask: Check the service or its access; the page names the failed calls.
briefs.alert_claim_lost: A runner lost its claim on a run
briefs.alert_backup: The instance's backup needs a look
briefs.alert_lowered: A process's autonomy level was lowered
briefs.alert_raise: Taktus proposes raising an autonomy level
briefs.page_edited: The page {page} was edited by hand
briefs.sender: A new sender of findings asks to be admitted
briefs.role_quiet: Report for {role}: nothing outside its range
briefs.role_switch_off: {process} is proposed to be switched off
